name: Booking-com/multi-destination-trip-dataset
what_it_holds: The official Booking.com WSDM WebTour 2021 'Booking Challenge' dataset, published directly by Booking.com on HuggingFace (mirrors bookingchallenge.com). Train: 1,166,835 anonymized hotel reservations; test: 378,667 (total 1,545,502 rows). Columns: user_id, checkin, checkout, affiliate_id, device_class, booker_country, hotel_country, city_id, utrip_id (multi-stop trips are grouped by utrip_id, each trip's final destination concealed in test). Data window visible in samples is 2016 (Aug-Dec); the original 2021 challenge release covers roughly 2016-2017 bookings across many city_id/hotel_country codes worldwide. License CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Not on GitHub itself (Booking.com's GitHub orgs, 'bookingcom' and 'Booking-com', hold no data repos) but is the authoritative, directly downloadable microdata release (parquet/CSV via the `datasets` library or bookingchallenge.com).
why_useful: Real booked (not just searched/quoted) reservation-level records with checkin/checkout dates let you derive length-of-stay and multi-destination trip-chaining distributions and booker_country x hotel_country flow tables for a major competitor OTA — a genuine, non-Airbnb building block for gap #9 (competitor/adjacent supply-demand) and gap #20 (party-size/length-of-stay/cross-border proxies, via trip chains). It is a materially bigger and more structured booking-level dataset than anything currently held for Booking.com beyond the 515k reviews file.
last_activity: Dataset card last updated 6 Dec 2024 on HuggingFace
themes: Booking.com datasets beyond the 515k reviews: listing/price snapshots, alternative-accommodation counts, Booking scrapers, WSDM/RecSys Booking challenge data

name: Booking.com RecTour 2024 Reviews Challenge dataset
what_it_holds: RecTour 2024 (ACM RecSys workshop, co-located, Oct 18 2024) challenge dataset: 2,031,914 anonymized, dated user-generated reviews from 50,000 Booking.com accommodations, with guest and accommodation context fields. Distributed via the RecTour organizers / Hugging Face (Booking-com/accommodation-reviews) rather than a plain GitHub repo, but the RecTour workshop series (github search: RecTour, rectour24) hosts baseline code and challenge scaffolding on GitHub each year.
why_useful: A large, dated (review-timestamped), non-Airbnb short-term-lodging review corpus at real scale (2M+ reviews, 50k properties) -- a genuine competitor (Booking.com alternative-accommodation) reviews-over-time dataset that could be used the same way as an Airbnb reviews stays-proxy, for a peer-comparison read-through. This extends what we already hold (RecTour24 user dataset, 515k Booking hotel reviews) with the newer, larger 2024 accommodation-reviews release.

name: getyourguide-reviews-scraper
what_it_holds: Single-commit scraper for GetYourGuide tour reviews: tour URL/activity name, reviewer traveler-type tag (e.g. 'Family with young children'), star rating, full review text, review date; handles pagination; exports to JSON/CSV/Excel/HTML. No dataset committed — it is an extraction tool, 0 stars.
why_useful: Review text + dates on a competitor Experiences marketplace could feed a demand/sentiment nowcast for tours & activities (adjacent to Airbnb Experiences), similar in spirit to the reviews-based 'stays index' already built for Inside Airbnb.
time_coverage: reviews carry their own posted dates; pull is current-state only

name: tripadvisor (API Evangelist profile)
what_it_holds: API Evangelist profile of Tripadvisor's public API surface (world's largest travel-guidance platform, owns Viator). Same spec/metadata-only format, no data.
why_useful: TripAdvisor's official Content API covers hotel reviews, attraction/experience listings and location data across cities globally — this repo is only a map to it, but is a lead toward a legitimate cross-city review-volume/rating panel spanning hotels AND experiences, which nothing in our current holdings covers jointly.

name: vrbo-api examples (StayingAPI)
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed REST + native MCP wrapper claiming live Vrbo (plus Airbnb, Booking.com, Google Hotels) search, availability calendars, and pricing in one normalized schema. Free tier via sandbox key (stay_test_ prefix, deterministic mock data); production keys need signup but 'no credit card', and 'failed/empty/blocked calls are never billed'. Only 3 commits; third-party (not an official Vrbo product - Vrbo itself has no public self-serve API). Also topic-tagged as vrbo-api, last topic update 21 Jul 2026 (recently active).
why_useful: Points to a commercial (not free) cross-platform normalization layer covering Vrbo — Airbnb's closest direct competitor supply-side (gap #9) — but it is a paid API, not open data, so value here is only as a pointer to what fields are obtainable, not a usable free source.
license: MIT (for the example code only; underlying API is paid)
themes: Airbnb API wrappers and search-page clients (catalogue only, never run): pyairbnb, airbnb-scraper, airbnb search results parsers; note what fields they expose
